seo.description: Compare TablePro with other database clients by features, supported databases, platforms and licensing. Includes dated facts and official sources.

header.title: Compare database clients
header.lead: Compare features, supported databases and licensing. Each comparison includes official sources and a checked date.

bySituation.title: Which client fits your work?
bySituation.lead: Start with the tools you need.
bySituation.tablepro: TablePro is a native, open-source client for several database types. AI chat and MCP are free in the Mac app. It imports connections from {apps}.

items.tableplus: Windows or Linux support, plus Vertica and Greenplum.
items.dbeaver: A cross-platform client with JDBC driver support.
items.datagrip: A database IDE with code inspections and version control. Free for non-commercial work.
items.navicat: Data modeling and shared projects through Navicat Cloud.
items.beekeeper-studio: An open-source client with the same features across Windows, macOS and Linux.
items.sequel-ace: A free Mac App Store client focused on MySQL and MariaDB.
items.sequel-pro: Moving from Sequel Pro? Its last release was {status.version}, on {status.date}. Compare Sequel Ace and TablePro.
items.postico: A focused PostgreSQL client with a one-time license.
items.heidisql: A free client for Windows, Linux and Apple silicon Macs.
items.phpmyadmin: MySQL or MariaDB access through your browser, including cPanel hosting.
items.mysql-workbench: Oracle’s MySQL tool, with SQL notebooks and MySQL Enterprise Backup integration.
items.pgadmin: PostgreSQL administration, with a debugger, pgAgent jobs and a shared-server option.
items.dbgate: An open-source SQL and NoSQL client for desktop and web.
items.mongodb-compass: MongoDB aggregation pipelines, schema analysis and live server metrics.
items.ssms: SQL Server administration on Windows, including Agent and Always On.

method.title: Sources and scope
paragraphs: Competitor facts use official websites, docs, repositories, release notes and store listings, or the package manager or platform vendor that distributes it. Sources include a checked date.
TablePro’s prices, platforms and features use this site’s shared product data. No reproducible benchmarks are cited, so these pages make no speed or memory claims.
Prices and features can change. <issues>Report an outdated fact on GitHub</issues>.
